title: Generate typed layer-port provider queries for editor choices
body: The editor view projection had to hand-code Provide opcode 4 and the field/set port names in VIXEN/application/editor/source/EditorApplication.cpp to populate ReadPort and port-valued argument selectors. The existing model-side proposal covers type inference and flattening, but the generated consumer surface still does not expose typed provider ports, matching queries, or selector payloads. Consolidate the declarative layer-port catalogue through the view/AppFlow consumer so editor choice rows and wire actions derive from the same source.

title: Author CLI required manual LD_LIBRARY_PATH provisioning
body: The paired undertow-author binary aborted before command parsing because the runtime could not locate ICU; the queued witness only ran after manually adding /home/liory/.local/opt/native-deps/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu and /home/liory/.local/lib to LD_LIBRARY_PATH. The documented bake pairing should carry its native runtime dependencies or provide a queue-safe launcher.

title: Parity harness had no supported target for editor VRC1 export
body: The exact editor-versus-author VRC1 witness had no supported consumer target, so I created a temporary harness and manually linked the build-tree static libraries. The first queued g++ command failed because glm/glm.hpp was not on the manual include path; recovery added build/wsl-debug/_deps/glm-src and build/wsl-debug/generated/include. Suggested consolidation: expose a supported queued VRC1 export/parity harness or target with its dependency include/link interface.
